verdict.rationale: Convex documents an official MCP server that "provides several tools that allow AI agents to interact with your Convex deployment", and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists. The docs also describe a production-safety default that blocks MCP access to production deployments unless enabled, which shows the server is a mature, deliberate feature. missing for 10: specific tool list and client setup/connection steps in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
